prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ETS', seasonality_champion='NaiveMovingAverage', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: Trend champion ETS (corr=1.0) and seasonality champion NaiveMovingAverage (corr=0.6605) split across different models, indicating decomposition-aware combination is valuable. Rankings are highly unstable (Kendall τ=0.076) with significant RMSE spread (4.27), suggesting robust median/trimmed_mean combination over single model selection. Early horizon specialist CWT_rf (2.30 RMSE) differs from late horizon specialist ONLY_FT_rf (3.84 RMSE), confirming per-horizon variation.
